body_v1.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-game character appearance proposals for Kagami, an adult mirror shrine priestess support.
Create EIGHT whole-body game-sprite drawings in a strict FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, each equal cell with generous transparent padding. No text, labels, borders, background, ground shadows or spell effects. All face screen-right in a 3/4 side view. Same recognisable woman, same size and flat light in every cell.
Design: long deep-violet hair in a high flowing ponytail with silver/lavender side ribbons, readable human face, ivory short shrine coat with lavender trim over a deep navy split hakama skirt/trousers, lavender waist sash, compact silver octagonal hand mirror clearly held by its handle, small crescent clasp. White tabi socks and dark sandals. An elegant athletic human silhouette; no armour bulk, no mermaid tail, no staff or sword. Bold moonlit silver, white, lavender and dark navy colour blocks, restrained simple shading.
Row1: idle with mirror held at waist; walk with right foot forward; walk with left foot forward; basic attack flicking a mirror shard with the free hand.
Row2: healing cast with mirror lifted; swap cast with mirror extended outward; hit reaction recoiling; kneeling defeat pose.
Style: original simple blocky pixel game sprites with clear dark outlines, consistent connected whole-body anatomy and a few flat shades. Approximately 42 logical visible pixels tall at game scale, broad enough to read beside stock champions. Draw complete poses, never separately sliced torsos and legs. Avoid tiny texture, glossy gradients, elaborate hair highlights, oversized floating jewelry, inconsistent camera angles, feet cropped by cells, or chibi proportions.
Genuine transparent background. This is a source sheet for low-resolution extraction, not a promotional illustration.
